display.purpose: Hero numerals and title-slide type only.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating overlays only (menus, popovers). Never on resting surfaces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; ink fill, paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #14110e; background: #14110e; color: #faf7f2; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff5a1f; border-color: #ff5a1f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary button; transparent fill, ink border, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #14110e; background: transparent; color: #14110e; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #14110e; color: #faf7f2; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: High-emphasis button reserved for the single live/actionable element per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #ff5a1f; background: #ff5a1f; color: #14110e; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #c2410c; border-color: #c2410c; color: #faf7f2; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14110e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Chip
components.description: Status chip marking the current/live chapter or room.
components.css: .ds-chip-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #ff5a1f; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff1e6; color: #c2410c; } .ds-chip-live__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ff5a1f; animation: ds-pulse 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.25; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, sharp-cornered content container with a hairline border.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Underline-only field; no box, no fill.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #14110e; border-radius: 0; color: #14110e; outline: none; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #ff5a1f; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a847c; }

narrative.overview: Phonosium is a sound installation — an immersive spatial work that treats acoustics as architecture. The site is its wayfinding layer: it reads like exhibition signage, not a marketing page. Large, confident architectural type sets the hierarchy; generous white space lets it breathe; a single vermillion accent does all the emphasis work, marking the one live element, current chapter, or call to action per screen. Monospaced technical metadata — timecodes, frequencies, room numbers, chapter indices — recurs as a structural motif, anchoring the work in something measurable. The voice is curatorial and third-person observational, like wall text in a gallery, never a pitch.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used sparingly and only for the live/actionable element
Flat surfaces — hierarchy comes from hairline rules and weight, not shadows
Large, tight-tracked Archivo display type paired with uppercase JetBrains Mono metadata
Mobile-first: legible and tappable at arm's length, outdoors, in person at the installation site

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Vermillion appears on one thing per view. Its rarity is the point — if more than one element on screen carries the accent, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for the technical voice — timecodes, frequency labels, room numbers, captions. Never for body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only for elements floating above the page, never as a decorative lift on cards or buttons.

dos: Do reserve vermillion (#ff5a1f) for the one live/actionable element per view — the current chapter, the primary CTA, the live indicator.
Do use 1px hairline ink borders and weight contrast for hierarchy instead of shadows or elevation.
Do set technical metadata (timecodes, frequencies, room numbers) in uppercase JetBrains Mono, tracked 0.04em.
Do keep layouts mobile-first with tappable targets — visitors check the schedule outdoors, at arm's length.
Do use confident, no-overshoot easing (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.1, 1)) for state transitions.
donts: Don't use rounded cards with heavy drop shadows — corners are sharp (0–2px) and surfaces are flat.
Don't use playful, bouncy animations — motion is restrained: 120–420ms, no overshoot.
Don't use emoji in UI copy or icons.
Don't use marketing superlatives ("amazing", "revolutionary") — the voice is curatorial, third-person, and observational.
